output.reply: Hi Maria, thank you for letting us know about the two $9.99 charges for Lumen Plus on the 3rd. We're sorry for the trouble and are looking into your billing records to confirm the duplicate. We'll follow up with you as soon as we've reviewed it.

Thanks for the suggestion! Automatic dark mode that follows the system setting isn't something Lumen offers yet, so for now switching it manually is the only option. I've passed your request along to our product team as feedback.

Thanks for reaching out! Lumen can export your notes, and the export option is usually found in your app's settings or notebook menu, but I'll confirm the exact Markdown export steps for your version and follow up shortly. In the meantime, let us know which platform you're using (web, desktop or mobile) so we can point you to the right place.

Thanks for letting us know, and for including your browser version. Since pasting tables from Google Sheets worked last week and now collapses into a single line, we're treating this as a bug and passing it to our team to investigate. If you can share a short sample of the table you pasted, that would help us reproduce it.

I'm sorry about the unexpected $120 charge for the annual plan. We're escalating your ticket so our billing team can review it against your March cancellation. Please have your cancellation confirmation email ready, as it will help the review.

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry you're locked out. Since the reset link goes to your old inbox, we'll need to verify that the account is yours before the email address can be changed. Please reply with the old email address on the account and any details that help confirm ownership, such as your workspace name, and our team will take it from there.

Sorry about this, especially with your exam coming up. Your notes with PDFs crashing the iOS app since the last update is something we want to look into. Could you tell us your iOS version and app version, and whether the crash happens with every note that has a PDF attached?

Thank you for reporting this, and I'm sorry about the timing with your client presentation. We've flagged it as urgent because your whole team can't reach Lumen, even though the status page doesn't show a problem yet. Please tell us whether anyone on your team can connect from a different network or device, as that will help us investigate.

Thank you for reporting this right away. We're treating it as a possible unauthorized access, so please change your password now, sign out of all other sessions and turn on two-factor authentication if you can. Please also remove the unfamiliar address from the two shared notebooks, and our team will review your account's recent activity and follow up with you.

Thanks for reaching out! To share a notebook, open it, click the Share button at the top right, and enter the email addresses of the people you'd like to invite, then choose whether they can view or edit. If you run into any trouble along the way, let us know and we'll be happy to help.

Thank you for reaching out. We have noted your request for an invoice showing Brandt Logistics GmbH and VAT number DE123456789 instead of your personal name. Our billing team will review it and get back to you with the next steps.

Thanks for letting us know about the word count showing 0 for notes that contain only emoji. This looks like a small display issue that doesn't affect your notes, and we've passed it along to the team to look into. We appreciate you flagging it!

Thanks for reaching out! Display name changes fall under your account settings, so you can update it there under your profile or account details. If the old nickname still appears next to your comments afterwards, let us know and we'll take a closer look.

Thanks for letting us know about the sync stuck on 'Syncing...' and the search returning no results. We're sorry for the trouble. We've logged both issues for investigation, and it would help if you could tell us your app version on the phone and laptop so we can look into your account.

Thank you for these suggestions: pinning notes to the top of a notebook, a default font size, and a longer 60-day trash retention. I've passed them along to our product team as feature requests. I can't promise if or when any of them will be added, but your feedback is appreciated.

Thank you for the detailed suggestion. A version history that shows who edited a note and when would help your team of 12 trace changes like a deleted paragraph. I've passed it to our product team as a feature request, and I can't promise whether or when it will be available.

Thanks for getting in touch, and sorry the Settings menu change made this harder to find. Weekly summary emails are usually managed in your notification or email preferences within Settings. Our team will follow up with the exact steps for the current layout.

I'm very sorry about the lost meeting notes, especially since this has now happened twice. We've escalated your ticket as urgent so our team can investigate whether your note can be recovered. Please don't delete or overwrite anything in the affected note, and if you can, let us know the note's title, your device and app version, and roughly when the spinner appeared.

Hello, and thank you for the kind words about Lumen. You are asking whether internal links keep working when a note moves between notebooks, and what happens to comments and edit history when two notebooks are merged. We will check how Lumen handles each case and send you a clear answer, and until then it would be safest to try the move and the merge on a small test notebook before touching your real data.

Thank you for the suggestion! An Android widget isn't available in Lumen at the moment, and we've passed your request on to our product team. We appreciate you taking the time to tell us what would make the app more useful for you.

Hola, lamentamos que no puedas acceder a tu cuenta. Revisa por favor la carpeta de spam y confirma que el correo que usas para restablecer la contraseña es el mismo con el que te registraste. Si sigue sin llegar, respóndenos con ese correo y revisaremos el problema con tu cuenta.

I'm sorry the mobile app is showing 'temporarily unavailable' again, especially on a third Monday morning. I've passed this on to our team as a recurring issue so they can look at the pattern. Could you tell us your app version and the time the error appeared today, and whether Lumen on the web works for you in the meantime?

Thanks for reporting these two problems with the Windows desktop app. We've logged both the freeze when opening notebooks with over 200 notes and the Ctrl+B shortcut sometimes inserting a literal 'b'. Our team will look into them, and it would help if you could tell us your Lumen app version and whether the Ctrl+B issue happens in a particular kind of note.

Thanks for your question, and for considering Lumen Plus. I can't confirm whether a student discount is available, so a member of our team will check and follow up with the details. In the meantime, the pricing page lists the current plans and what each one includes.

Thank you for letting us know, and we're sorry for the disruption to your office. We've logged your report of the 503 errors affecting your team since about 9:15 this morning and are treating it as top priority. We'll share updates as soon as we have more information, and you can also follow our status page.

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the trouble. We've noted both problems: your account still showing the free plan after the $48 charge, and your two teammates being unable to see the shared notebooks. We'll look into both and follow up with you here.

Sorry you're locked out, especially with something time-sensitive. Our support team will review your account lockout and the lost two-factor device, and we'll likely need to verify your identity before we can help restore access. Please reply with the email address on the account so we can start that process.

Thanks for letting us know. Images showing as broken icons after an Evernote import points to a problem with the import itself, so we'd like to look into it. To help us investigate, could you tell us roughly how many notes are affected and whether you used the Evernote export file (.enex) or another method? In the meantime, please keep your original Evernote export so it's available if a re-import turns out to be needed.

Thank you for considering Lumen for your team. I've passed your SAML single sign-on requirement with Okta to our product team, and I can't share or commit to a roadmap date. We'll follow up with whatever we can confirm about SSO support for your evaluation.

Thanks for reaching out. Deleting an account is something we can help you with, and I'm passing your question about exactly which data is removed and how long it takes to our team so they can confirm the details for you. Please don't delete anything until you've heard back, in case you want to export your notes first.

Bonjour, merci pour votre message. Le changement de moyen de paiement relève de la facturation : l'option se trouve généralement dans les paramètres de votre espace, section Abonnement ou Facturation, et nous pouvons aussi vous guider pas à pas si vous ne la voyez pas. Pouvez-vous nous indiquer si vous êtes administrateur de l'espace de travail et ce que vous voyez dans cette section ?

Sorry to hear Lumen is running slowly for you. To help us look into it, could you tell us which device and app (web, desktop or mobile) you are using, and whether the slowness happens everywhere or only with certain notes or notebooks? We'll check on our side once we have those details.

Thanks for the suggestion! Alphabetical sorting of notes isn't something Lumen offers right now, and we've passed your request along to our product team. We can't promise if or when it will be added, but we appreciate you telling us what would make Lumen work better for you.

I'm sorry about the unexpected charge and the overdraft it caused. I've flagged your ticket as urgent so our billing team can review the $480 charge against the $48 you expected. We'll follow up with you once they've looked into it.

Thanks for reporting this. We understand the share link lumen.example/s/ab12 shows a 404 page for your coworkers, and we're looking into it. To help us investigate, could you tell us whether the notebook's sharing settings are still turned on and whether a newly generated link behaves the same way? No refund has been issued, as this ticket is about the link problem.

Thanks for letting us know that image uploads have been failing with 'Upload failed, try again' since this morning while text notes still work. We've logged this as a bug and our team will look into it. To help us investigate, please tell us which device or app you're using and the file type and size of the screenshots.

Thanks for reaching out! We're looking into how multiple accounts work on a single phone and will confirm whether you can sign in to separate work and personal Lumen accounts on the same device. If you tell us which phone and app version you use, we can give you more specific steps.

Thanks for reaching out! We'll send you the steps for turning on offline mode and confirm whether it covers notebooks your teammates have shared with you. We'll also include the storage allowance for the Plus plan in our follow-up.

Thanks for letting us know, and sorry about the distracting underline. I've passed this on to the team as a spellcheck issue. To help us look into it, could you tell us which app you're using (web, desktop or mobile) and its version?

Thanks for getting in touch, and we understand you need this by the end of the day. We're checking how to save a note as a reusable template in Lumen and will send you the steps, or the closest alternative, as soon as we can. Could you tell us whether you're using the web, desktop or mobile app so we can point you to the right place?
